Prerequisites: Deadly Lancer class feature

Divert the crashing power of your dive attacks to the terrain around your target. After landing a dive attack on a grounded target, you may subtract two Deadly Lancer dice from your damage to cause all ground within 5 feet of that target to become difficult terrain. You may further increase this area of effect by subtracting an additional two Deadly Lancer dice for every 5 feet gained. Additionally, creatures caught in its area of effect must make a Reflex save (DC: 10 + the original amount of Deadly Lancer dice) or be knocked prone.
